description: UI-build tasks. Each composes registered components; deliberately scoped to what Aperture DS covers, so a framework-following agent can reach ~100% consistency while a cold-generation agent will hand-roll and drift.

tasks.title: Pricing tier card
tasks.brief: A pricing card for the 'Pro' tier: a 'Most popular' status pill at top, the tier name as a heading, a one-line description, a large price ($29) with a '/mo' caption beside it, three feature lines, and a full-width primary call-to-action button 'Choose Pro'. Card should read as an elevated surface.

tasks.title: Login form card
tasks.brief: A sign-in form inside a card: a 'Welcome back' title, a subtitle, an email field (label + input), a password field (label + input), a full-width primary 'Sign in' button, and a secondary/ghost 'Create account' button below it. Vertical layout with consistent spacing.

tasks.title: Settings toggle row
tasks.brief: A single settings list row: on the left a label 'Push notifications' with a secondary helper line 'Get notified about activity', and on the right a toggle switch (on). The row is horizontally laid out, label block left, switch right-aligned, with comfortable padding. Wrap it in a surface.

tasks.title: Metric stat card
tasks.brief: A small dashboard stat card: a caption label 'Monthly revenue', a large display number '$48.2k', and a success-toned badge showing '+12.5%' indicating growth. Stacked vertically on a surface.

tasks.title: Profile header
tasks.brief: A user profile header row: a circular avatar on the left, then a vertical block with the person's name (title) and their role 'Product Designer' as secondary text plus a small neutral badge 'Pro', and on the right a primary 'Follow' button. Horizontal layout, vertically centered.

tasks.title: Notification toast
tasks.brief: A toast notification: a success badge/dot, a short bold title 'Saved' with a body line 'Your changes were published.', and a ghost 'Undo' button on the right. Elevated surface, horizontal layout.
